name: valmo.in
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request and headless Chrome while it carried the review tag; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome without the tag. Partial analysis: 4 of 4 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.valmo.in scores 71 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 23 are at risk, and 22 pass. Fix first: plain http…

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, for example .gap-2.flex-\[1_0_45\%\].items-start:nth-child(1) > .pl-0.text-\[0\.8rem\].text-\[\#738195\] and a[href$="[address hidden]"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw cookies mp_a66867feba42257f4b46689d52d48f86_mix….
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: The start page took 6310 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

fix.title: Share cards are missing og:image, twitter:card
fix.evidence: LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Slack, and X build the preview from these tags. The preview in this report shows what they would show today.
fix.fix: Add the missing Open Graph and Twitter tags to every page template.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
Every page has a meta description
The start page sets a mobile viewport
